blocks.text: BPI certification for compostable products (Biodegradable Products Institute). Source description: Biodegradable Products Institute provides certification services for compostable products. BPI-certified products meet ASTM D6400 or D6868 testing standards to certify they will biodegrade in a managed compost facility. Full text is not stored (license: link_only). See https://bpiworld.org/.
